subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Raj Rajaratnam Case
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Raj Rajaratnam Case.

hook.text: A hedge fund billionaire traded on tips from insiders at Goldman Sachs, Intel, and Google.

buildup.text: Raj Rajaratnam's Galleon Group used a network of corporate insiders feeding nonpublic information.

discovery.text: The FBI used wiretaps for the first time in a securities fraud case — and recorded everything.

twist.text: His insider network included corporate executives, consultants, and even a Goldman Sachs board member.

climax.text: He was sentenced to 11 years — the longest insider trading sentence at the time.

punchline.text: His phone calls made him rich. His phone calls put him in prison.

quiz.question: What new investigative technique did the FBI use in the Rajaratnam case?
